preconditions.description: The number of months n is between 2 and 500,000 inclusive.
The first line of array values contains exactly ceil(n/2) integers.
The constant income x for the second half is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= val <= 10**9 for val in a_first)
preconditions.description: Each income value in the first half is within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: output_k == -1 or (1 <= output_k <= n and all(sum(a[i:i+output_k]) > 0 for i in range(n - output_k + 1)))
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 (indicating no solution) or an integer k between 1 and n such that every contiguous subarray of length k in the full income array has a strictly positive sum.

postconditions.expression: output_k != -1 or not any(all(sum(a[i:i+k]) > 0 for i in range(n - k + 1)) for k in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: If the output is -1, then no integer k exists that satisfies the condition that all contiguous subarrays of length k have a positive sum.
